court_cases: Multiple public Indian court records found on Indian Kanoon (indiankanoon.org): (1) Bombay High Court, Commercial IP Suit No. 293 of 2022 — Entod Pharmaceuticals Ltd & Anr v. Alliance Pharmaceuticals Ltd, orders dated 12.04.2022, 03.07.2023, 05.08.2026, 12.08.2026, 09.10.2026; Entod is PLAINTIFF in the 2022/2023 orders and appears as RESPONDENT in the 2026 orders (counter-claim/IA 2055-2026), i.e. cross-suits between the same parties; status: pending/ongoing as of the latest order 09.10.2026. (2) Bombay High Court, Commercial IP Suit No. 295 of 2023 — related Entod matter, pending. (3) Delhi High Court, W.P.(C) 11808/2024 — Entod Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. & Anr v. Union of India & Ors, order dated 02.09.2024; Entod is PETITIONER (writ against Union of India, heard together with Alkem Laboratories W.P.(C) 11807/2024). (4) Delhi High Court, W.P.(C) 12491/2024 — Entod Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. & Anr v. Union of India & Ors, order dated 12.09.2024; Entod is PETITIONER. All are civil/commercial and writ matters; no criminal proceedings identified. Note: the writ petitions against Union of India are consistent with a regulatory dispute, but the underlying regulator action could not be verified (see news_risk).
